culprit_citations.quoted_text: Denali Equity Holdings LLC (2) | Class A units | 09/2024 | 3,749 | $ | 347,531 | $ | 339,136 | 216.77 | %

findings.detail: Denali fair value was extracted as 2522500, but the source row reports fair value of 339136000 for the comparative Denali investment and 354399000 for the current-period Denali row.

Denali cost was extracted as 347854000 from a funded/purchases amount rather than the Denali investment row, whose source cost is 347531000 in the comparative investment table and 340995000 in the current-period table.

rationale: Class 2 row check. The flagged holdings row says Denali Equity Holdings LLC has cost 347854000 and fair_value 2522500, causing fair value to appear below 5% of cost. Raw source rows for Denali instead show fair value of 339136 (thousands) in the detailed investment table and 354399 (thousands) in the current-period underlying-project table. The low fair value is therefore a real extraction/column-mapping error, not an economically distressed position.
